# Independent challenge of the continuous-slab certification gate

## Decision and useful results

All three exported first slabs fail decisively: the original uniform-enrichment candidate, the localized-weight follow-up, and one reduced-only constrained-Galerkin test. These are rejections of the immutable candidates, not of tAMEn or every tensor-time approach.

Localized-weight repair: exact integrated residual is at least 7.17097266849711e-5, and a rigorous physical-state comparison with an outward mass enclosure gives actual augmented-state l1 error at least 1.509585413105462e-4. The detailed repair section below explains the representation-specific obstruction.

Latest constrained test: the broad enrichment direction was removed, while the localized basis and every physical parameter were held fixed. The all-50 coordinate alone gives a rigorous integrated full residual lower bound of 1.4918533657070469e-5. This exceeds the entire 1e-9 interior budget without a full residual Gram contraction. No additional basis generation, tuning, simulation, or propagation was performed by this verifier.

1. Exact full-operator separating-functional verification gives

   integral from 0 to 0.0001 of ||q'(t) - G q(t)||_1 dt >= 0.06901324601471871.

   Initial and join defects are exactly zero. The result includes the overflow scalar. It exceeds both the proportional-time planning share 1e-13 and the entire 1e-9 interior budget. A planning share is an allocation, not a necessary accuracy threshold. This lower bound prevents the usual full-forward-residual certificate from fitting the entire budget for this trajectory, even if all later slabs were exact. It does not itself lower-bound success-probability error.

2. A separate exact localization argument proves a genuine error of the represented state:

The simpler unbalanced witness independently gives 0.06900097517355237. These results concern the augmented state, not the success coordinate alone.

# A direct certificate for the actual first-slab hitting output

Root derivation, 2026-10-16. Exact mathematical model only; internally checked, not external review, measured chemistry or historical novelty. The supplied three TT trajectories are for h=1/10000 (the candidate manifest stores that decimal as a string), starting at all eight counts50 on the actual open2x4 graph. Target is first entry into all counts<=15. Birth b(n)=2.676n(n-1)+108.102, death d(n)=.040n(n-1)(n-2)+37.881n, and each directed diffusion has rate8.2207 times the source count. All rates here are exact rationals.

## Stopped counting lemma

For integer50<=U<162 stop at the first coordinate reaching U+1. Before this time all coordinates<=U. A coordinate's total upward intensity is at most B_U=b(U)+3DU, because maximum graph degree is3. The stopped upward counter is stochastically bounded by Poisson(B_U h), by the standard independent potential-event/thinning construction for a predictable bounded intensity. Reaching U+1 from50 requires at least U+1-50 upward jumps; deaths cannot help. Therefore the probability of any upper exit by h is at most8 times that Poisson tail. Independence of coordinates is not assumed.

If the target is reached before the upper exit, total count falls from400 to at most120. Diffusion conserves total count and births increase it. At least280 reaction deaths are therefore required. Their aggregate stopped intensity is at most8d(U). Its counter is dominated by Poisson(8d(U)h). A union bound yields

    P(tau_target<=h) <= 8 P(Pois(B_Uh)>=U-49)
                        + P(Pois(8d(U)h)>=280).

This applies to the capped and original unbounded process: paths leaving the smaller box are all charged to the upper-exit event. No global deadline-one overflow allowance is spent. This argument supplies an upper bound, not an approximation based on a modified generator.

INDEPENDENT KINETIC ADVERSARY: EXACT SCOPES AND ALTERNATIVE CERTIFICATES
2026-10-16. Internal mathematical reconstruction, not external validation.

1. Model and immutable candidates

Read-only capital pin: 9dbe934e5475f415c2d160a6c0715534aafa546b.
Actual finite process: {0,...,162}^8 plus one overflow sink; target B is the
whole frozen grid subset {0,...,15}^8. Its mass, not a second duplicate sink,
is the success output. The initial law is delta_(50,...,50). All ten edges
of the open 2x4 ladder are retained in both directions. The exact rates are

 b(n)=2.676 n(n-1)+108.102,
 a(n)=0.040 n(n-1)(n-2)+37.881 n,
 directed i->j diffusion rate D*n_i, D=8.2207.

The decimal constants are exact rationals. Overflow is absorbing failure.
The augmented column generator G conserves mass and has nonnegative off-
diagonal entries. The grid generator alone is substochastic. Nothing here
certifies an IEEE implementation, experimentally calibrated chemistry, or
the actual horizon-one rare-event probability.

Each saved first-slab export, with h=1/10000, defines an exact polynomial
through its binary64 dyadic coefficients:

 y_j(t)=initial_j+sum_(k=1)^32 c_jk[T_k(2t/h-1)-(-1)^k].

In particular y_j(h)=initial_j+2*sum_(odd k)c_jk EXACTLY. There is no floating
endpoint cancellation in this formula. Every initial coefficient and each
core of the initial delta were checked. All other localized basis cores have
literal zeros outside counts 39,...,61. Thus their exact target contraction
vanishes for every t, and full generator action grows their support only to
38,...,62. No physical transition was cropped to obtain this statement.

The original and weighted candidates each add one rank-one broad direction.
For that direction g(x)=product_i w_i(x_i), exact success is

 q_B(h)=y_0(h)*product_i(sum_(n=0)^15 w_i(n)).

The constrained candidate has no broad direction; its success output is
identically zero on the entire polynomial, not just small at one endpoint.
Its overflow polynomial is also literally zero. Safe NPZ inspection bounded
the uncompressed arrays before loading; allow_pickle=False was always used.

2. What the old rejections establish

Let p(t)=exp(tG)p0 and R=q'-Gq. With exact initialization,

 q(h)-p(h)=integral_0^h exp((h-s)G)R(s) ds,
 ||q(h)-p(h)||_1 <= integral_0^h ||R(s)||_1 ds.

Therefore a LOWER bound on the integral of ||R||_1 does not lower-bound
actual endpo
